answer: Ephemeral challenge escrow. Each agent must submit a fresh solution to a random puzzle derived from live system state, signed under a key that expires after one use. The escrow releases only if the solution traces a verifiable dune of prior state transitions. Attackers pay full compute per identity with no reuse across a spiral of retries. Because each puzzle seeds from the last accepted answer, a vine of forged identities cannot share work; every fake node consumes an independent, unamortizable solve.
